public_source_signal: annual Access and Functional Needs Card exists and is requested from residents needing assistance
operational_risk: card exists but roster may be stale, incomplete, duplicate, or not linked to transport assets
minimum_closure_artifact: current dated AFN roster extract with municipality/zone, de-duplication method, outreach coverage, owner signoff, hash, redaction class

public_source_signal: card asks for municipality and contact information
operational_risk: record not geocoded to EPZ/evacuation sector or pickup route
minimum_closure_artifact: geocoded sector/municipality crosswalk with QA sample and public-safe aggregation

public_source_signal: card asks whether resident is mobility impaired
operational_risk: mobility category not translated into vehicle type, staff, lift, stretcher, oxygen, or caregiver need
minimum_closure_artifact: mobility-to-vehicle assignment table with wheelchair van/ambulance/accessible bus vendor roster and backup capacity

public_source_signal: card asks whether transportation is needed and what type
operational_risk: no dispatchable manifest, rendezvous point, accessible vehicle timeline, or no-show procedure
minimum_closure_artifact: transport assignment manifest with anonymized demand counts by type, pickup points, dispatch times, alternate providers, exercise observation

public_source_signal: card asks about hearing, vision, and TTY needs
operational_risk: alert path may fail for Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing, blind/low-vision, LEP, or TTY-dependent residents
minimum_closure_artifact: accessible alert test log: WEA/EAS/siren follow-up, ASL/captioning/plain-language message, TTY/relay/door-knock fallback, language-access QA

public_source_signal: public route/reception guidance assumes resident movement to reception/mass-care centers
operational_risk: AFN residents may require durable medical equipment, electricity, dialysis, oxygen, caregiver, medication cold-chain, or service-animal accommodation
minimum_closure_artifact: medical-dependency continuity matrix linked to pickup, receiving facility, backup power, medication, service-animal/pet accommodation, and privacy review

public_source_signal: public materials tell residents to return cards annually
operational_risk: low response rate or unreturned cards creates hidden demand
minimum_closure_artifact: annual outreach/return-rate dashboard with underserved geography, LEP, age, disability, and no-vehicle correction actions

public_source_signal: tri-state EPZ crosses Pennsylvania, Ohio, and West Virginia
operational_risk: AFN registries and transport assignments may not transfer across county/state lines during route diversion
minimum_closure_artifact: cross-border AFN mutual-aid interface control document with common data fields, privacy limits, dispatch handoff, and exercise proof

public_source_signal: public school movement tables exist for Ohio side and public resources list school/reception routing
operational_risk: children with disabilities and medically fragile children may be missing from standard bus estimates
minimum_closure_artifact: school-day AFN annex with current enrollment, IEP/medical transport count aggregate, accessible bus/ambulance assignments, reunification messages, exercise observation

jurisdiction: BVPS EPZ long-term care / hospital interface
public_source_signal: public medical movement tables exist for Ohio side and public materials acknowledge special medical problems
operational_risk: current census, ambulance contracts, receiving facility acceptance, decon routing, and staff escort may be unproven
minimum_closure_artifact: LTC/hospital movement or shelter exception packet with current aggregate census, transport resources, receiving agreements, decon/contamination control, CAP/retest

jurisdiction: BVPS EPZ reception and mass-care centers
public_source_signal: public reception centers and mass-care capacity context exist
operational_risk: listed capacity may not include accessible toilets, cot spacing, power, water, dialysis/oxygen charging, behavioral health, or pet/service-animal flow
minimum_closure_artifact: accessible reception/mass-care facility readiness packet with ADA survey, staffing, backup utilities, medical support, animal/service-animal plan, drill timestamp

public_source_signal: public sources point to sirens, EAS, public safety brochures, and alert registration
operational_risk: rumor/misinformation can cause shadow evacuation or AFN non-compliance if messages are inaccessible or inconsistent
minimum_closure_artifact: JIC message package with language/ASL/captioning/plain-language versions, disability/farmer variants, rumor-control log, and exercise evaluation
